proposed.text: What is the liability effect if the same registered architect signs as Architect-of-Record and also accepts Architect-in-Charge of Construction supervision duties on the same project?

options.text: The construction role replaces the Architect-of-Record responsibility for design documents
The architect may face the responsibilities attached to each role actually accepted: design documents as AOR and construction supervision as AiCC
RA 9266 requires two different architects for the roles in every case
The contractor alone becomes responsible for both design and construction defects
